verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's docs describe templates as the way to set up a rented machine with whatever software you need (docs-30), let you build a template that packages your environment (docs-38), and launch custom templates with one click (docs-13). Templates are also managed from the CLI (docs-2), and the image config editor accepts docker create/run options for any Docker image (docs-52). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bringing an arbitrary or private-registry Docker image (registry auth), deeper detail on the template build process, and independent hands-on corroboration.
